data.name: Private Everglades Airboat Tour
data.headline: Your Exclusive Everglades Adventure:
data.description:
Start Your Everglades Adventure Today
The wonders of the Everglades are waiting for you. At South Florida Airboat Adventures, we're ready to guide you through this unique ecosystem, sharing our knowledge and passion for this incredible natural treasure. Discover wildlife, and take in the breathtaking beauty of the natural landscape. Ideal for nature lovers, families, photographers, and adventure seekers looking for a deeper connection with this one-of-a-kind ecosystem.
data.what_is_included:
Private airboat for your group (up to 6 people)
Expert local captain with deep knowledge of the Everglades
Alligator sightings guaranteed (in natural habitat)
Panoramic views of sawgrass marshes and wildlife
Safety equipment and noise-cancelling headsets
Cooler with ice and water
Free parking on-site
data.what_to_bring:
To make the most of your airboat adventure, we recommend bringing the following:


Weather-appropriate clothing: Lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing for hot, humid weather, or layers for cooler months.
Sunscreen: The Florida sun can be intense, so please protect your skin with SPF.
Hat and Sunglasses: To shield your eyes from the sun.
Closed-toe shoes: For safety when boarding the airboat.
Camera: Capture the stunning wildlife and scenery (but please secure your camera with a strap to avoid dropping it)
Insect Repellent: The Everglades can have mosquitoes, especially near the water's edge.
Water: Stay hydrated on your journey.
Food and Drinks: Feel free to bring your own snacks, bottled water, or non-alcoholic beverages. Alcohol is allowed tours.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
data.booking_notes: Glide across the Everglades on a private airboat tour with South Florida Airboat Adventures, where it’s just you, your group, and your captain exploring the river of grass. Experience the beauty and wildlife of the Everglades up close at your own pace, creating a personalized and unforgettable adventure.
data.restrictions: Our airboats are designed to accommodate most guests, but accessibility can vary. We recommend calling ahead to discuss any specific needs or concerns, especially for those with mobility challenges. Some airboats may require stepping onto a platform or boat, so please let us know if you need assistance.
